text:
Maya (Support): hey @Alex_Billing — customer ACME Health says Invoice INV-2026-042 charged 8.5% WA sales tax but their billing address is Columbus, OH. they're refusing to accept the charge because their legal entity is OH. Blocked on PO completion.
Alex (Billing): can you drop the invoice link + account id and whether they paid with card or PO?
Maya (Support): acct_73XG, invoice https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-042. payment method = PO (net30). Billing address on their account: 123 Main St, Columbus, OH 43215. The PO submitted has a separate "bill_to" block with Seattle address (Seattle Medical LLC, 500 Pike St, Seattle, WA) 
Alex (Billing): thanks. that looks like the root of the mismatch. who triggered tax calc? @Sam (Payments Eng) can you pull our tax request/response for that invoice?
Sam (Payments Eng): reproducing locally now. steps: 1) GET /internal/billing/invoices/INV-2026-042 -> shows invoice.billing_profile.address = {city: "Columbus", region: "OH"} but invoice.po.bill_to = {city: "Seattle", region: "WA"}. 2) we POST to tax service with "tax_location": invoice.po.bill_to (BUG). 3) tax provider returned rate 0.085 (WA) and tax_amount = 45.23. taxbot shows: `Avalara resp: {transaction_id: "tx_9f3", nexus_detected: ["WA"], tax_rate: 0.085}`
Maya (Support): so our system used the PO's bill_to not the account billing address? customer insists bill_to on PO is for internal routing only and should not define tax jurisdiction.
Priya (Finance): if that's true we need to refund the tax and reissue invoice immediately. is this a one-off or a systemic bug?
Sam (Payments Eng): looks systemic for PO flows. code path `calculate_tax_for_invoice()` picks precedence: `po.bill_to || billing_profile.address || account.country` — that should be `billing_profile.address || po.bill_to` for US sales tax (we treat PO as auxiliary). I can put a hotfix to change precedence. quick patch: in billing-service: `taxLocation = billing_profile.address ?? po.bill_to`. Also add a flag `po.is_tax_authority` to allow explicit overrides in future.
Alex (Billing): any fallout for invoices already issued? ~20 invoices with PO bill_to in last 24h. need a list and refund plan.
Sam (Payments Eng): running query: `SELECT id FROM invoices WHERE payment_method = 'PO' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND po.bill_to.region is not null AND billing_profile.address.region != po.bill_to.region;` returns 18 invoices.
Priya (Finance): prepare refund batch for tax lines only. approvals: refunds < $10k auto, but some may be >10k. loop in @CFO.
Maya (Support): I'll tell the customer we found the issue and we'll reissue a corrected invoice and credit the tax. Proposed message: "We identified a misrouting of PO billing address for tax calculation; we will credit the tax amount and send an updated invoice within 48 hours." OK?
Alex (Billing): yes. please include that they don't need to resubmit the PO. we will honor current PO number.
Sam (Payments Eng): plan: 1) push hotfix to staging now (change precedence + add unit tests), 2) run tax integration regression suite (covers VAT and US states), 3) deploy to prod in 24-36 hours if green. roll forward and monitor. rollback plan: revert change and manually correct tax lines for affected invoices.
taxbot: Tax request sent -> `payload.tax_location = {region: "WA", city: "Seattle"}`; response `200 OK` rate=0.085.
Maya (Support): customer update sent, they replied :thumbsup: and asked for the credit memo ID once issued.
Priya (Finance): I'll assemble refund batch and flag >10k for CFO approval.
Sam (Payments Eng): putting PR up now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/512 — includes new precedence logic + test vectors including PO with different bill_to. staging build is running.
Alex (Billing): thanks — can we also add a quick check in the invoice generation UI to show "Tax jurisdiction used: <state> (source: billing_profile / PO)" so CS can see why a tax was charged?
Sam (Payments Eng): good idea. will add small UI tag in second PR.
Maya (Support): marking this as P1 for support escalation. I'll update the ticket once refunds issued.
Priya (Finance): note for bookkeeping: if tax was collected for WA but customer is OH, we must remit refund and correct exemption forms if provided.
Sam (Payments Eng): ETA: hotfix to staging in <2h, prod deploy in 24-36h pending tests.
Maya (Support): resolved for customer (pending credit). will follow up with memo IDs. :white_check_mark:
